description: Implementation of the CookieInclusionStatus class managing cookie exclusion and warning reasons, including methods for adding, removing, comparing reasons, and generating debug strings.

classes.name: CookieInclusionStatus
classes.description: Represents the inclusion status of cookies, including reasons for exclusion and warnings, with methods to manipulate and evaluate these reasons.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two CookieInclusionStatus objects based on exclusion and warning reasons.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two CookieInclusionStatus objects.

methods.name: IsInclude
methods.description: Returns true if the cookie is included (no exclusion reasons).

methods.name: HasExclusionReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific exclusion reason is present.

methods.name: HasOnlyExclusionReason
methods.description: Checks if only a specific exclusion reason is set.

methods.name: AddExclusionReason
methods.description: Adds an exclusion reason.

methods.name: RemoveExclusionReason
methods.description: Removes an exclusion reason.

methods.name: RemoveExclusionReasons
methods.description: Removes multiple exclusion reasons.

methods.name: ExclusionReasonsWithout
methods.description: Returns exclusion reasons excluding specified reasons.

methods.name: MaybeClearSameSiteWarning
methods.description: Clears certain warning reasons based on exclusion reasons.

methods.name: ShouldRecordDowngradeMetrics
methods.description: Determines if downgrade metrics should be recorded based on exclusion reasons.

methods.name: ShouldWarn
methods.description: Checks if any warning reasons are set.

methods.name: HasWarningReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific warning reason is present.

methods.name: HasSchemefulDowngradeWarning
methods.description: Checks for specific schemeful downgrade warnings.

methods.name: AddWarningReason
methods.description: Adds a warning reason.

methods.name: RemoveWarningReason
methods.description: Removes a warning reason.

methods.name: GetBreakingDowngradeMetricsEnumValue
methods.description: Returns downgrade metrics enum value based on URL and warning reason.

methods.name: GetDebugString
methods.description: Generates a debug string representing the current status.

methods.name: HasExactlyExclusionReasonsForTesting
methods.description: Tests if current exclusion reasons match provided reasons.

methods.name: HasExactlyWarningReasonsForTesting
methods.description: Tests if current warning reasons match provided reasons.

methods.name: ValidateExclusionAndWarningFromWire
methods.description: Validates wire format of exclusion and warning reasons.

methods.name: MakeFromReasonsForTesting
methods.description: Creates a CookieInclusionStatus object for testing with specified reasons.

methods.name: ExcludedByUserPreferences
methods.description: Checks if cookie is excluded solely by user preferences.
